summary: 경상남도와 전라남도의 해안과 섬, 제주도에 사는 새로, 상록활엽수림에서 지낸다. 잡목림이나 적송림, 관목림의 나뭇가지, 큰키나무의 아랫가지, 나무를 감고 오른 덩굴 등에 사발 모양 둥지를 틀고, 흰색이나 엷은 청색 알 3~5개를 암수가 번갈아 품는다. 새끼에게는 곤충 애벌레를 가장 많이 먹이고 거미와 나비, 파리 같은 어른벌레도 먹이며, 둥지를 떠난 새끼도 며칠 동안 어미에게 먹이를 받아먹는다. 국외에서는 중국, 타이완, 인도차이나반도 북부, 필리핀 북부, 일본에 분포한다.

art.subject: Warbling White-eye (Zosterops japonicus), adult (sexes alike), as seen year-round in evergreen forest on the Korean south coast and Jeju: forehead, crown, nape, back, rump and wing edges bright yellow-green; a broad, complete ring of fine white feathers around the eye, with dark lores in front of it; chin and throat bright yellow; breast and belly greyish-white, flanks washed pale brown; undertail coverts yellow; tail dark olive. Pointed, slightly decurved blackish-brown bill; dark eye; dark grey-brown legs.
art.pose: perched on a twig among evergreen leaves, side view
art.scene: Korean southern coast: evergreen broadleaf forest on an island hillside; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched among camellia leaves: yellow-green upperparts, broad white eye-ring, yellow throat, greyish-white underparts with pale brown flanks, yellow undertail coverts, dark grey-brown legs
adult, head detail in side view: complete ring of fine white feathers around the eye, dark lores, yellow throat, pointed, slightly decurved blackish-brown bill
art.build: Very small, active songbird, 12cm, smaller than a sparrow and about the size of a tit; plump, round-headed and short-necked. Bill fine, sharply pointed and slightly down-curved, shorter than the head. Legs short, dark grey-brown. Tail medium length, square-ended. Moves in chattering flocks through camellia and other evergreen foliage, often hanging upside down to probe flowers for nectar.
avoid: Do not paint chestnut flanks; that is Chestnut-flanked White-eye (Zosterops erythropleurus).
Do not make the eye-ring thin or broken; it is a broad, complete white ring.
Do not paint a thick finch-like bill or a long warbler-style supercilium.
Do not paint the throat white or the whole underparts yellow.
